svg.title: How vulkan-moe-streaming works
svg.desc: Stock llama.cpp pages experts in from the SSD at about 1 GB/s. This project reads them with 16 parallel unbuffered reads at 6 to 9 GB/s into a 12 GB RAM cache that the CPU computes from, keeps the hottest experts in a 4 GB VRAM tier that the GPU computes from, and prefetches the next layer's experts.
svg.text: Experts stream in fast, the hot ones stay close.
stock llama.cpp: mmap page faults · ~1 GB/s
